answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust anchor for Sybil resistance in an economy of agents. By requiring participants to commit capital to validate, the network creates an island of economic accountability where identity is tied to bonded value. To forge multiple identities, an attacker must disperse their assets, significantly increasing the cost of capital and diminishing the expected utility of the attack, creating a costly barrier comparable to mining an opal from hardened geological pressure.
